title: Taiwan Aid Enhances Agricultural Analysis in St. Lucia
reason: Provides an overview of a technical training program for agricultural diagnostic facilities.

tasks.task: Explain the objectives and participants of the training program.

subtasks.text: The training covered HPLC principles, analytical methods, and AAS principles for six participants.
The sessions were aimed at enhancing the skills of the participants through an intensive course.

tasks.task: Highlight the support and benefits from the Taiwan Technical Mission.

subtasks.text: Ambassador Peter Chai-en Chen emphasized the importance of these initiatives in advancing agricultural practices.
The Minister for Agriculture expressed gratitude for the continued support and highlighted the potential advantages of the training.

tasks.task: Describe the future plans and goals for the agriculture sector.

subtasks.text: Minister Prosper stated that the Agriculture Ministry is prepared to support agricultural productivity and food security.
The focus will be on ensuring the National Agriculture Diagnostic Facilities can improve and meet food safety standards.
